title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode9 A Place to Breathe Easy

meta.Episode: Episode9 — A Place to Breathe Easy
meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 3-E

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I feel a little sleepy after staying up so late reading those magazines...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This is bad. I can't let my guard down since I don't know who might be watching.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Morning, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
Good morning. It's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, like a month or so, I think?
You've been pretty busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, I saw your new lip gloss commercial!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As usual, it's like seeing a totally different person when you're on TV. I felt this little jolt go through my heart.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm so happy for you.
Despite everything that happened, work seems to be going really well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
*Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's sad that I don't get to chase after the same dream as Airi anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad that she's still going after it...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Because Airi's an idol who's been spreading hope to people for as long as I can remember.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Including back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Spit it out already! Being indecisive is the worst thing in our line of work! The fans pick up on it and start to get worried!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know that. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Why aren't you saying anything...?
That's the same as saying they're right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But the rumors are true...
For a little while now, the other members and I haven't been getting along very well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...
Can you tell me more?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I felt so much better after Airi was so understanding of what I was going through.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We ended up going down different paths, but I should continue to support her as she pursues her dream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I also saw your joint stream.
I thought it was very fun...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did...? Then, it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
To be fair, all I did was talk.
I'm nothing like you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Nothing like me...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because you're always dazzling everyone who looks at you, and you encourage them to do their best, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I can't really do that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I disagree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You always make me feel those things, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You carefully read through the comments, carry out requests and make sure everybody gets to have fun...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really admire how you're always doing your absolute best for your fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, right after I'd quit being an idol, it was like there was a big gaping hole in my heart, and I couldn't think about anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But seeing the way you hadn't changed at all since the first time was what inspired me to keep moving forward and trying my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, thank you always being such a wonderful person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you as well...
I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's both keep placing importance on having heart!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I'm worried about you working too hard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, just look at the huge bags under your eyes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
I did stay up late last night studying the latest fashion trends...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly... I get why you're trying so hard, but you also need to take your mind off of things from time to time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Take my mind off of things...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, Airi, why don't we have lunch together today? It's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Talking with you is just so much fun, Airi, and it should help me relax... Would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... I'm not against it, but I already promised to have lunch with someone else today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Someone else?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I promised one of the second-years that we'd have lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's actually an idol.
I ran into her while she was passing out flyers in front of the station.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, she's a student here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really...? That's quite the coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? We were going to have lunch while I told her more of what I thought about her show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But how would you feel about joining us, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? Wait, Airi, it sounds she's really looking forward to talking to you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry since she seems to be a fan of idols in general. If anything, she's probably gonna be ecstatic about getting to talk to you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, if you don't feel comfortable, then you and I can have lunch together at a later date!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If she's a fan of idols, then she likely sees me as that perfect person who can do anything.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I'd have to keep my guard up...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I don't know when I'll get to see Airi next, and I am curious as to what this girl is like.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
In that case, would it be alright if I joined you two?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, no problem!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, there's the bell.
See you later.
se_walk_women_002_1
Lunch break
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<I'll be sitting on the bench under the tree.>
Send...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, I've let her know where we are, so she should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. You said her name is Minori Hanasato, yes? I'm looking forward to meeting her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I also need to be very careful not to leave her disillusioned...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mooomoooiii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Thank you for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've hardly been waiting at all. I only messaged you a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You came over here in a hurry, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I've really been looking forward to having lunch with her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, what..?!
Y-You're...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Today's special guest is Shizuku Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-This is incredible...!
Even the air around you sparkles!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I hope you'll forgive the sudden intrusion.
Would it be alright if I joined you two today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-O-O-O-O-O-O-Of course!
In that case, I'll give you two some space by sitting a little further away.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why would you do that? You're the star of today's show, remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm here to tell you what I thought about your show, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd also like to hear about what it was like.
Especially since it's very difficult to earn Airi's seal of approval.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, you sit right here in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Hehe... Pardon me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ...and seeing you do your best dancing made me want to try harder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I really appreciate you saying that Airi since you're such a veteran idol!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's incredible.
Airi hardly ever showers people with praise like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. She seldom praises me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Every once in a while is plenty.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You two seem so close!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
One of my friends from class is called Shiho. She's your little sister, right, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wait, Minori, you know Shiiー
I mean, you're friends with my younger sister?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, she's been such a good friend!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for being friends with her, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, what do you two talk about normally?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm... Homework, nice things that have happened recently...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also! We talk a lot about bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bunnies?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's a member of the animal caretaker committee, right? I was also member when I was a first-year, so we take care of them together from time to time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait just a moment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii's on the animal caretaker committee? This is news to me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I mean, she's a high schooler now.
She isn't gonna say everything to her family.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand that...
But I wish she would've told me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, it sounds like the perfect committee for her since she loves cute animals so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
She takes such good care of them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She apparently even takes notes on each one's personality and holds and pets them each one differently based on her observations...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She always acts cools, but she's a nice girl who really cares about those around her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she is...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I got lost at the station just the other day, she came all the way over to help me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, lost...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?
*Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Th-This is bad...!
Getting to talk about Shii made me so happy that I ended up letting my guard down.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... Not lost, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even when I looked at the map, I couldn't quite figure out where I was.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's called getting lost!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hinomori, does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What do I do? If I've ended up disappointing Minori...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You can be a little absent-minded sometimes?
That's really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry! I realize that you're my senior...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the thing.
She's actually more of an airhead than you realize.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, she can be a handful sometimes...
But she also provides this sense of comfort.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think I sorta know what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The Shizuku I see on TV and in magazines always seemed like a divine being who's both cool and beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But talking about Shiho just now, you had such a kind smile on your face, Hinomori... Just talking to you is filling me with so much warmth.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm glad that I got to learn about this other side of you. I apologize if I'm overstepping, but I feel much closer to you now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She really feels that way...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was convinced that I'd just disappoint everyone around me if I acted like myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But there are people out there who are willing to accept me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori. Would you mind keeping this a secret between just us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I'd like to remain the perfect version of Shizuku Hinomori in front of everyone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?
But I think the person I'm talking to now is a wonderful person...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'll keep it a secret since you're my senior! It's going with me to the grave!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But, umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A part of me would like to see more of this side of you from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For some reason, I feel like I can really breathe...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I believed that I had to be the person everybody wanted me to be at all times...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But sitting here in this place...
I feel like I can relax a little.)
I'm sure somebody out there will accept you for who you really are, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That voice... Am I hearing things?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But... That's right.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Minori?
How would you feel about us having lunch together again sometime?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd love to learn more about you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
Of course! In that case, I'll make sure to prepare a really amazing self-introduction!
